summary: A scrollable account form with three TextFields (work email, company, role) and a StickyActions bar with a stretched Continue button, wrapped in the keyboardAware action.
use: A form that stays operable with the on-screen keyboard open: the page scrolls, the focused field comes into view and the action bar rides above the keyboard and the safe area.
spec: `<TextField label="Work email" type="email" bind:value={email} autocomplete="email" />`, then `Company` and `Role` fields with matching `autocomplete`
A filler `div` of at least `8rem` so the form scrolls
`<StickyActions align="stretch">` holds `<Button variant="filled" type="submit">` whose label becomes `Sent` after submit
